items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Oh no, I never played no jobs with Buddy Petit, but I mostly would be there with him, you know, all the time.

ctx.x: Did you ever work with Buddy Petit? Ever play any jobs with Buddy Petit?

Oh no, I never played no jobs with Buddy Petit, but I mostly would be there with him, you know, all the time. I wasn't playin' then when I used to go around with them, but then I used to go around to the dance. I didn't pick it up yet until the late chapter, around after, before World War I. I picked it up a couple of times, a couple of months before World War I.
Who would, who did you like on clarinet? Any favorite players on clarinet?
